text: Jordan spent Lena's last day at Meridian going through the muted office ritual (cake, hollow well-wishes from Marcus) before walking her out, where Lena offered to refer Jordan for a design role at Northlight — only for Jordan to reflexively deflect with "I don't think I'd have good enough experience," a response Lena firmly pushed back on. Afterward Jordan felt unsettled, recognizing the self-doubt as an automatic reaction rather than a genuine belief, especially since Jordan had privately acknowledged the dashboard work was strong just days earlier. No firm decision was made beyond agreeing to let Lena put her name forward, but Jordan is left dreading the quieter, lonelier office without her.
